items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: We'd jam up there every morning... Tatum get up... I'd always run and grab the bass... I used to give Art Tatum a fit, 'cause every time I'd pick up a bass, and he was playing, he'd get up

ctx.x: And do you remember some of the musicians that you hung out listening to? At night?
Oh, yeah. Eddie Byas and Don Byas, Art Tatum, Al Morgan and Eddie Barefield had just left Cab Calloway out here; and some of the local musicians -- let's see,
